coverage_b70_l15.notes: All inspected frames retain coherent vegetables, cutting tools, hands/arms and counter structure. No subject disappearance or white collapse. Higher PSNR/SSIM and slightly better LPIPS than B80.

coverage_b80_l10.notes: Normal complete scene with no collapse. Slightly faster and marginally better flow/flicker, but lower PSNR/SSIM than B70 and no clear visual advantage.

coverage.selection_notes: Freeze B70/L15 as the usable basic clustering route because it is the strongest structural-fidelity candidate and remains 1.22x faster than Dense without visual collapse.

hybrid_b75_r10.notes: Normal scene and subject preservation, but slightly more appearance drift and worse LPIPS/flow/flicker than B80 while also being slower.

hybrid_b80_r20.notes: Normal scene across the inspected sequence, with coherent hands/tools and no large missing or white regions. Best hybrid balance of LPIPS, flow, flicker and end-to-end time.

hybrid.selection_notes: Freeze B80/R20. It is faster and better on LPIPS, flow and flicker than B75; its small PSNR difference does not outweigh the multi-metric and runtime advantage.

vaware_prototype_b80.notes: Complete stable scene with no visual collapse. It has lower PSNR/SSIM than residual scoring, but better LPIPS, flow, flicker and runtime.

vaware_residual_b80.notes: Complete stable scene and stronger PSNR/SSIM, consistent with captured output-error screening. It is slower and worse on LPIPS, flow and flicker on this calibration video.

vaware.selection_notes: Freeze the prototype variant as the standalone V-aware route because five-metric/video evidence favors its perceptual, temporal and speed balance. Residual scoring remains in the final hybrid, where captured-QKV output error was strongest.

review_basis.reviewer: Codex visual contact-sheet review plus full-video decoded metrics
